displayName: Pmitz sandbox server: someone created a sandbox

documentation.content: An assistant created a Pmitz sandbox. To see who and what they did, run `node who.mjs 1` in hosted-mcp of the pmitz-plugin repository. Calls made as `node` or `curl`, which is how the gateway's own tests call, are not counted.

conditions.displayName: A sandbox created by an assistant

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="logging.googleapis.com/user/pmitz_sandboxes_created" AND resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND metric.labels.client!="node" AND metric.labels.client!="curl"
